opening.argument: The promotion presents an Android app as a route to real, free Visa gift cards, while directing viewers to install and play other apps to earn credits. Its own materials describe the exchange mechanism: “you can play other apps from this app and then you can get credited,” with Visa-card thresholds of 3,000 credits for $10 and 7,500 for $25. The app further displays an install-game option, a Visa redemption screen, and a history of game activity and credits. Although the speaker calls the app “a real app” and says it is working, the evidence does not establish successful gift-card delivery, complete eligibility terms, fees, or data requirements.
